svg.title: Any Cell, Any Time
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: a patchwork quilt hangs from a pole between two posts, seen at an angle, three squares across and three down. Above its columns are a square, a triangle, and a diamond, and a thread circle sits beside each row. Most squares are sewn with simple stitched designs; one, at the left of the middle row, is empty. A mannequin reaches up to fit a single hatched patch into it. The quilt is the site's table: its columns are guides, governance, and theory (the square, triangle, and diamond) and its rows are threads. The sewn squares are pieces other people have already contributed. The hatched patch is one contribution, the focus: a single guide, governance piece, essay, or pattern. Adding it while the rest of its row is unfinished is the solution: accept a contribution to any single cell at any time. The metaphor: a community quilt, made one patch at a time by whoever has one ready, and uneven until it's done.
